steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Apply the available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is created.
Add the specified product and requested quantity.
Complete remaining required pricing-sheet fields.
Choose the requested delivery location.
Verify the requested product was selected.
Verify the product variant was filled automatically.
Verify the requested quantity.
Verify the selected delivery location.
Enter the exact title containing special characters.
Add one available QA test vendor for publication and vendor-portal verification.
Commit the default 30-minute schedule.
Publish the configured RFQ event.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Verify the exact title on the published project page.
Return to the Events list to verify the published event appears there.
Verify the Events list rendered successfully.
Verify the exact special-character title is preserved in the Events list.
Open the invited vendor's supplier portal session.
Open this event in the vendor portal overview.
Verify the vendor portal displays the exact same title.
